title: 1793 French constitutional referendum
text: A constitutional referendum was held in France in 1793 and 1794. While most voting took place in July 1793, the last day of voting was not until 4 April 1794 when residents of Châteaulin voted. The new constitution was approved by over 99% of voters. However, due to the 13 Vendémiaire, the constitution was never enacted.
